items.title: 2.1.1.2 Setting Up Python Development Environment (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Development environment ka matlab hai computer ko is tarah tayyar karna ke us par Python code achhi tarah likha, chalaya aur debug (ghaltiyan dhoond kar theek) kiya ja sake. Is mein zaroori software, tools aur libraries install aur configure (set) karna shamil hai, ta ke kaam aasani aur tezi se ho. Python ko https://www.python.org/ se download aur install kiya ja sakta hai (kitab yeh pata beech mein spaces ke saath chhapti hai). Python shuru karte waqt achha Integrated Development Environment (IDE), yani code likhne aur chalane ka program, kaam aasan bana deta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Python install karte waqt "Add Python to PATH" wala box zaroor tick karein. Is se Python command line se aasani se chalti hai. Hum online services (websites) par bhi Python program likh aur chala sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Python ko command line se aasani se chalane ke liye install karte waqt kya karna chahiye (MCQ 2)?
blocks.explanation: 'Add Python to PATH' tick karein, option (c).

items: Development environment: Python aur zaroori tools install aur set karna.
IDE coding aasan banata hai; install par "Add Python to PATH" tick karein.
